facts.fact: The Constitutional Court on 4 December 2025 (Petition No. 13 of 2020) held section 1(2)(b) of the ATIA, the exemption for court records before a case concludes, unconstitutional, treating the Act as law in force.
facts.system: The Access to Information Act, Cap 95

note: Ruling is a constitutional challenge to a provision, not a decision on a request made under the law, so no reach fact.
